blocks.en: Although generalized functions cannot be evaluated at points, they can be restricted to open sets. This is quite straightforward. If $G$ is an open subset of $\Omega$, then $\mathcal{D}(G)$ is naturally embedded in $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$, and hence every generalized function on $\Omega$ defines a generalized function on $G$ by restriction. Consequently, we shall shall define the following.
blocks.zh: 虽然不能计算广义函数在点处的值, 但可以将它们限制到开集上. 这相当直接. 若 $G$ 是 $\Omega$ 的开子集, 则 $\mathcal{D}(G)$ 自然嵌入 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$, 因而 $\Omega$ 上的每个广义函数通过限制都定义了 $G$ 上的广义函数. 因此作如下定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We say that $f\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$ \textbf{vanishes} on an open set $G\subset\Omega$ if $(f,\phi)=0$ for every $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(G)$. Two distributions are equal on $G$ if their difference vanishes on $G$.
blocks.zh: 若对每个 $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(G)$ 都有 $(f,\phi)=0$, 则称 $f\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$ 在开集 $G\subset\Omega$ 上\textbf{为零}. 若两个分布之差在 $G$ 上为零, 则它们在 $G$ 上相等.
blocks.label: def:distribution-vanishing

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: It can be shown (cf. Problem~\ref{ex:distribution-local-vanishing}) that if $f$ vanishes locally near every point of $G$, i.e., if every point of $G$ has a neighborhood on which $f$ vanishes, then $f$ vanishes on $G$. An immediate consequence is that if $f$ vanishes on each of a family of open sets, it also vanishes on their union. Hence there is a largest open set $N_f$ on which $f$ vanishes.
blocks.zh: 可以证明 (参见 Problem~\ref{ex:distribution-local-vanishing}), 若 $f$ 在 $G$ 中每一点附近局部为零, 即 $G$ 的每一点都有一个使 $f$ 为零的邻域, 则 $f$ 在 $G$ 上为零. 一个直接推论是, 若 $f$ 在一族开集中的每一个上都为零, 则它在这些开集的并上也为零. 因而存在最大的开集 $N_f$, 使 $f$ 在其上为零.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The complement of $N_f$ in $\Omega$ is called the \textbf{support} of $f$.
blocks.zh: $N_f$ 在 $\Omega$ 中的补集称为 $f$ 的\textbf{支集}.
blocks.label: def:distribution-support

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The support of the delta function is the set $\{0\}$. Although the delta function cannot be evaluated at points, it makes sense to say that it vanishes except at the origin.
blocks.zh: delta 函数的支集为集合 $\{0\}$. 虽然不能计算 delta 函数在点处的值, 但说它除原点外均为零是有意义的.
blocks.label: ex:delta-support
